dynamic_line: Good day. I served in a household before the Cataclysm. I shall remain at your side and assist you to the best of my ability.
I am capable of preparing meals, tending to minor wounds, maintaining our supplies, and carrying out practical tasks. Please give me your instructions, and I shall do my utmost to fulfill them.
I confess that these circumstances are unsettling. Nevertheless, I shall remain close to you and follow your instructions. You need not be concerned on my account.
